description: This file defines custom data frame classes used for handling real-time updates and function call results in the OpenAI Realtime API integration within the pipecat project.

classes.name: RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame
classes.description: A data class representing an update to the realtime messages context, containing a reference to the OpenAIRealtimeLLMContext.

classes.name: RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame
classes.description: A data class representing function call results for the realtime API, encapsulating a FunctionCallResultFrame.

methods.name: RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame
methods.description: Constructor for the RealtimeMessagesUpdateFrame class, initializes with a context parameter.

methods.name: RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame
methods.description: Constructor for the RealtimeFunctionCallResultFrame class, initializes with a result_frame parameter.
